name: Articles - Awesome Pi Coding Agent
description: Blog posts, discussions, and community coverage from around the web · A new Emacs mode for AI-assisted coding (Claude Code style), with native Emacs buffers instead of a flickering terminal. Built on top of pi, a no-bs open source Claude Code alternative. It supports Claude, GPT, Gemini, Ollama.
